title: Reindexing top correlation
statement: Let $I$ and $K$ be finite index sets, let $e:I\to K$ be a bijection, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on sign assignments indexed by $K$. The average of $f$ times the product of all coordinate signs is unchanged when the assignments are reindexed along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on sign assignments indexed by $K$
